content:
Whether it be online shopping or social media, secular forces are propelling consumer internet businesses forward. But it's not all sunshine and rainbows as consumer purchasing power can make or break demand. This unpredictability is weighing on the industry as its 7.6% return over the past six months has fallen short of the S&P 500's 11.7% gain.

The elite companies can churn out earnings growth under any circumstance, however, and our mission at StockStory is to help you find them. With that said, here is one internet stock boasting a durable advantage and two we're steering clear of.

Two Consumer Internet Stocks to Sell:

Based in Tel Aviv, Fiverr (NYSE:FVRR) operates a fixed price global freelance marketplace for digital services.

Active Buyers have declined by 14% annually over the last two years, suggesting it may need to revamp its features or user experience to stay competitive

Projected sales decline of 23% for the next 12 months points to a tough demand environment ahead

Excessive marketing spend signals little organic demand and traction for its platform

Fiverr is trading at $9.53 per share, or 1.3x forward price-to-gross profit. If you're considering FVRR for your portfolio, see our FREE research report to learn more .

Founded to help people in rural areas get online medical consultations, Teladoc Health (NYSE:TDOC) is a telemedicine platform that facilitates remote doctor's visits.

Sales were flat over the last three years, indicating it's failed to expand its business

Focus on expanding its platform came at the expense of monetization as its average revenue per user fell by 9.2% annually

Estimated sales decline of 5.2% for the next 12 months implies an even more challenging demand environment

Teladoc's stock price of $6.90 implies a valuation ratio of 8.6x forward EV/EBITDA. Check out our free in-depth research report to learn more about why TDOC doesn't pass our bar .

One Consumer Internet Stock to Buy:

Founded by Stanford students with the intent to build "the local, on-demand FedEx", DoorDash (NASDAQ:DASH) operates an on-demand food delivery platform.

Orders have increased by an average of 23.5% annually, giving it the potential for margin-accretive growth if it can develop valuable complementary products and features

Excellent EBITDA margin of 20% highlights the efficiency of its business model, and its rise over the last few years was fueled by some leverage on its fixed costs

Additional sales over the last three years increased its profitability as the 98.3% annual growth in its earnings per share outpaced its revenue

At $210.25 per share, DoorDash trades at 20.8x forward EV/EBITDA. Is now the right time to buy? Find out in our full research report, it's free .

chineseTitle: 1 只基本面令人印象深刻的互联网股票和 2 只我们质疑的股票
chineseSummary: 无论是在线购物还是社交媒体，世俗力量都在推动消费互联网业务向前发展。但并不全是阳光和彩虹，因为消费者的购买力可以创造或破坏需求。这种不可预测性正在给该行业带来压力，因为过去六个月该行业的回报率为 7.6%，低于标准普尔 500 指数 11.7% 的涨幅。
chineseContent:
无论是在线购物还是社交媒体，世俗力量都在推动消费互联网业务向前发展。但并不全是阳光和彩虹，因为消费者的购买力可以创造或破坏需求。这种不可预测性正在给该行业带来压力，因为该行业过去六个月 7.6% 的回报率低于标准普尔 500 指数 11.7% 的涨幅。

然而，精英公司在任何情况下都可以实现盈利增长，而我们 StockStory 的使命就是帮助您找到它们。话虽如此，这里有一只拥有持久优势的互联网股票，还有两只我们正在避开。

两只值得出售的消费互联网股票：

Fiverr（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FVRR）总部位于特拉维夫，运营着一个固定价格的全球数字服务自由职业市场。

过去两年，活跃买家每年下降 14%，这表明它可能需要改进其功能或用户体验以保持竞争力

预计未来 12 个月销售额将下降 23%，表明未来需求环境严峻

营销支出过多表明其平台的有机需求和吸引力很少

Fiverr 的交易价格为每股 9.53 美元，即远期市盈率的 1.3 倍。如果您正在考虑将 FVRR 作为您的投资组合，请参阅我们的免费研究报告以了解更多信息。

Teladoc Health（纽约证券交易所股票代码：TDOC）是一个远程医疗平台，旨在帮助农村地区的人们获得在线医疗咨询，为远程医生就诊提供便利。

过去三年销售额持平，表明其业务扩张失败

专注于扩展其平台是以牺牲货币化为代价的，因为其每用户平均收入每年下降 9.2%

预计未来 12 个月销售额下降 5.2%，意味着需求环境更具挑战性

Teladoc 的股价为 6.90 美元，意味着远期 EV/EBITDA 的估值率为 8.6 倍。查看我们的免费深入研究报告，详细了解 TDOC 未通过我们标准的原因。

值得购买的一只消费互联网股票：

DoorDash（纳斯达克股票代码：DASH）由斯坦福大学的学生创立，旨在打造“本地按需联邦快递”，运营着一个按需食品配送平台。

订单每年平均增长 23.5%，如果能够开发有价值的互补产品和功能，就有可能实现利润增长。

20% 的出色 EBITDA 利润率突显了其商业模式的效率，过去几年的增长得益于其固定成本的一定杠杆作用

过去三年的额外销售提高了盈利能力，每股收益年增长率 98.3% 超过了收入

DoorDash 的交易价格为每股 210.25 美元，远期 EV/EBITDA 为 20.8 倍。现在是购买的合适时机吗？请在我们的完整研究报告中找到答案，它是免费的。
